headline: 英國藝人開放讀者提問
context: 英國藝文界這週有兩則讀者提問活動。演員約翰・漢納（John Hannah），以《Four Weddings and a Funeral》、《Sliding Doors》、《Spartacus》等作品聞名，近期主演一部以GoPro拍攝的新驚悚片，開放讀者提問。搖滾樂團Evanescence主唱艾米・李（Amy Lee）也開放讀者提問，內容涵蓋樂團九零年代起家、MTV走紅歷程，以及作為男性主導樂種先驅的經歷；樂團今年六月發行第六張專輯《Sanctuary》，九月將推出黑膠版本，並展開英國巡演。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Your mum’s favourite star of Four Weddings and a Funeral, Sliding Doors, Spartacus and a new GoPro-filmed thriller is ready to answer your quetions He’s your mum’s favourite, after playing the jolly nice man who is jolly nice to Gwyneth Paltrow in Sliding Doors, and the jolly nice man who delivers the heartbreaking WH Auden eulogy for his partner in Four Weddings and a Funeral . But there is far more to John Hannah than a Scottish accent, magnificent eyebrows and an unrivalled ability to look soulfully concerned. In The Mummy films, he played treasure-hunting comic relief Jonathan Carnahan. In 2002’s Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde, he took on both halves of Robert Louis Stevenson’s character. He played a psychopathic killer in Truth or Dare, and appeared opposite Denzel Washington in The Hurricane. On TV, he has been a transhumanist scientist in Marvel’s Agents of SHIELD ; a gruff but compassionate emergency medicine chief in Transplant; and a gladiator school owner in the blood-soaked, boobs-and-sandals epic Spartacus – which might have given your mum a shock if she was expecting more Mr Nice Guy. He was also the scientist at the beginning of The Last of Us who warned everyone that a fungi could destroy humanity – so don’t blame him, he did try. Continue reading...
sources.title: Post your questions for John Hannah

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: The metal icon is here to answer your questions about the band’s 90s origins, MTV fame and being trailblazer in a male dominated genre It is 23 years since Evanescence released one of the defining debut singles of the 2000s, Bring Me to Life, frontperson Amy Lee’s account of escaping an abusive relationship. Since then, the Arkansas band – essentially Lee’s project – have become a towering force in rock, selling millions of records, winning Grammy awards and reshaping how the genre can sound thanks to their inclusion of classical music and piano-led balladry. In June, the band released their sixth album, Sanctuary, produced by former Bring Me the Horizon member and now metal super-producer Jordan Fish. The album, Lee has said, confronts the political turmoil of her country, and stands “against tyranny, against human rights violations, against blowing people up”. The record arrives on vinyl for the first time in September (after its digital release in the summer) and heralds an in-demand UK tour. Continue reading...

thread_text:
英國藝文界這週有兩則讀者提問活動。

演員約翰・漢納（John Hannah），以《Four Weddings and a Funeral》、《Sliding Doors》、《Spartacus》等作品聞名，近期主演一部以GoPro拍攝的新驚悚片，開放讀者提問。搖滾樂團Evanescence主唱艾米・李（Amy Lee）也開放讀者提問，內容涵蓋樂團九零年代起家、MTV走紅歷程，以及作為男性主導樂種先驅的經歷；樂團今年六月發行第六張專輯《Sanctuary》，九月將推出黑膠版本，並展開英國巡演。

—— 本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月 12、13 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。

voice_text: 這禮拜，有兩位藝人開放讀者提問。演員約翰・漢納，以《Four Weddings and a Funeral》、《Sliding Doors》、《Spartacus》這些作品聞名，最近主演一部用GoPro拍攝的新驚悚片。搖滾樂團Evanescence的主唱艾米・李，也會回答讀者的提問——內容包括樂團九零年代怎麼起家、怎麼靠MTV走紅，還有她作為男性主導樂種先驅的經歷。樂團今年六月發行了第六張專輯《Sanctuary》，九月會推出黑膠版本，並展開英國巡演。
